summary: Script code (PowerShell module, entry point) is well-crafted: Set-StrictMode, proper error handling, clear exports, mockable design. Workflow YAML follows conventions: pinned refs, least-privilege, sensible triggers, proper job dependencies. BUT: workflow references ./tests/DependencyLicenseChecker.Tests.ps1 (unit-tests job, line 32) without creating it or validating it exists — when `act push` runs, this step fails immediately. Similarly, scripts assume fixtures/config files present (package.json, license-config.json, license-db.json) with no setup steps. Workflow won't execute; unshippable as-is. Code quality 4-5/5, but deliverable completeness 1/5.
